'''Hayner's Mercantile''' was a business operating in the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It sold several kinds of articles, including but not restricted to food and simple weapons. The business was owned by [[Gillis Hayner]].
